environment: One Xeon Gold 5317 physical host; two independent Linux 6.6.0-rc6-dcd-v3 L1 kernels; nested KVM; emulated coherent shared 2GiB CXL device-DAX; Linux target 1 vCPU/128MiB.

validation.continuity_checks: integer register, RIP and x87 accumulator

recommendation_reason: Poll5 saved only ~35us at the median, increased controller CPU from ~4-5% to ~40-41% of one CPU each and did not improve p95. Full busy spin did not improve latency enough to justify CPU use.
stage_statistics_note: Paired per-transition stages sum exactly to that transition. Means can be added; stage medians do not sum to overall p50. Guest-progress wait includes executor wake, nested VM entry, guest loop and observation; it is not pure polling.

discarded_async_resume.reason: Changed control ACK latency but did not improve actual guest-progress end-to-end latency; removed from final runtime.

collection_notes: First v2 control test completed all transitions; read-only recollection fixed aggregation of optional Firecracker-only timing fields. Original failed report retained.
Later offline aggregation excludes unavailable zero-valued metrics from the other execution path; raw timing samples and overall metrics unchanged.
limits: CPU/FPU 77us case begins after a completed HLT, unlike the Linux source-stop-request boundary; it is a restricted diagnostic, not a 128MiB Linux VM context-switch result.
Context benchmark reports median of trial means; VM report shows per-transition p50/p95.
Controller CPU accounting excludes Firecracker and vCPU execution threads; percentages include dwell and verification time.
Guest working-set validation completes before the next switch, outside first-heartbeat downtime.
Existing Firecracker control/device runtime stays on A; no block/network/vsock transfer.
Fixed addresses/PFNs, compatible CPU/VMCS and cooperative single owner required; native lock waiters cannot transfer.
RCU/SRCU reader drains remain; shared arena blocks are not reclaimed until lab shutdown.
Physical multi-host CXL coherence, latency and crash recovery are not validated.
CPU/FPU HLT diagnostic includes FD/mmap and register/FPU continuity validation; it is not a hardware context-switch lower bound.
post_collection_source_note: Only host-side optional-metric aggregation and documentation changed after the final runtime tests; kernel, Firecracker and shared-probe source/binaries match the tested image.
